overview.description: The Eaton Vance Mortgage Opportunities ETF (EVMO) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in broad credit fixed income. The fund is actively managed, investing in a broad range of US mortgage-related securities. It uses top-down and bottom-up analysis to select securities across a range of maturities and credit qualities. EVMO was launched on Mar 31, 1987 and is issued by Eaton Vance.
